page-layout: full

These are some resources and readings that I've encountered that may be useful for students in mathematics and related fields. I've saved a random assortment of these over the years, and compiling this table is also a way to keep my own bookmarks organized.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import html
import yaml
from IPython.display import Markdown

candidates = [
    Path("pages/Resources/resources.yml"),
    Path("resources.yml"),
    Path("data/resources.yml"),
]
resource_file = next((p for p in candidates if p.exists()), None)
if resource_file is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("resources.yml not found")

with resource_file.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    items = yaml.safe_load(fh) or []

all_keys = set()
for item in items:
    all_keys.update(item.keys())

preferred_order = [
    "title",
    "organization",
    "audience",
    "stage",
    "type",
    "deadline",
    "location",
    "duration",
    "stipend",
    "tags",
    "notes",
    "apply_url",
    "url",
    "id",
    "last_updated",
]
ordered = [key for key in preferred_order if key in all_keys]
for key in ordered:
    all_keys.remove(key)
ordered.extend(sorted(all_keys))

if "title" in ordered:
    ordered = [key for key in ordered if key not in {"url", "apply_url"}]


def render_value(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, list):
        parts = []
        for item in value:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                part = ", ".join(
                    f"{html.escape(str(k))}: {html.escape(str(v))}" for k, v in item.items()
                )
                parts.append(part)
            else:
                parts.append(html.escape(str(item)))
        return ", ".join(parts)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return ", ".join(
            f"{html.escape(str(k))}: {html.escape(str(v))}" for k, v in value.items()
        )
    return html.escape(str(value))


rows = []
rows.append('<div class="table-responsive">')
rows.append('<table id="resources-table" class="display resources-table" style="width:100%">')
rows.append("<thead><tr>")
for key in ordered:
    rows.append(f"<th>{html.escape(key.replace('_', ' ').title())}</th>")
rows.append("</tr></thead>")
rows.append("<tbody>")

for item in items:
    rows.append("<tr>")
    for key in ordered:
        if key == "title":
            title_text = html.escape(item.get("title", "Untitled"))
            apply_url = item.get("apply_url") or ""
            url = item.get("url") or ""
            link = apply_url or url
            if link:
                title_html = (
                    f'<a class="resource-link" href="{html.escape(link)}" '
                    f'target="_blank" rel="noopener">{title_text}</a>'
                )
                extra = ""
                if apply_url and url and apply_url != url:
                    extra = (
                        ' <br><span class="small-muted">'
                        f'<a href="{html.escape(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">info</a> '
                        "• "
                        f'<a href="{html.escape(apply_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">apply</a>'
                        "</span>"
                    )
                rows.append(f'<td class="title">{title_html}{extra}</td>')
            else:
                rows.append(f'<td class="title">{title_text}</td>')
            continue

        rows.append(f"<td>{render_value(item.get(key, ''))}</td>")
    rows.append("</tr>")

rows.append("</tbody>")
rows.append("</table>")
rows.append("</div>")

Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```
